> 第1章 楔子（第1页）
深秋，在一处破败的寺庙内，有一头发花白、满脸皱纹的老人斜倚着一张破旧木桌休息，一个十三、四岁少年依靠在他身边，两人身下铺着一层柴草。
少年虽衣着褴褛、灰尘遮面但依旧无法遮盖脸上流露出的那一丝英气，老人、少年均是一脸疲惫。
皎洁的月光洒满大地犹如给大地披上一件“银纱”
，远处不时传来几声犬吠，一片萧瑟清冷。
原本紧闭双眼的少年，忽然眨动几下眼睑，然后就发出一声尖叫：“不要杀我爹娘、我的哥哥！”
这声尖叫打破了清冷夜晚的寂静，引起几声犬吠。
老人也被少年的尖叫声惊醒，他转头看了一下身旁的少年，脸上满是慈祥，眼中流露出只有亲人才有的宠溺之情。
只见老人无比心疼的轻拍了几下少年肩膀，口中轻声自语又好似在安抚身旁少年说：“少主，近半月以来，我们一路逃亡，东躲西藏、风餐露宿，奔走在死亡边缘，你何曾受过这种苦难？”
老人本想轻拍少年几下，让少年平静下来后好再睡一会，但是少年却在此时突然睁开了双眼。
只见少年睁大眼睛看着老人，眼中有晶莹的泪珠出现，他平静了一下心绪说道:“白爷爷，我们什么时候才能到外公家啊？”
被少年称作白爷爷的老人说道:“少主，按照这个速度，大约5天后就到了。”
说话的少年名叫张皓旸，是安平城张家的少主，老人是他家的仆人名叫白邵阳。
白邵阳与张皓旸的爷爷关系非同一般，当初因张皓旸的爷爷张振龙救过白邵阳一命，白邵阳为报救命之恩，以仆人的身份在张家守护年轻一代。
张振龙本意是与白邵阳兄弟相称，但奈何白邵阳一直不同意，以救命之恩犹如再生父母为由反复拒绝，见白邵阳态度如此坚决，张振龙就只能随他心意。
白邵阳在张家虽是以仆人身份出现，但张家众人却从未将白邵阳当做仆人看待，张皓旸与其兄张皓峰更是尊称白邵阳为白爷爷。
张皓旸缓缓站起，走到庙门口，眼神坚定的看着安平城张家的方向，他有些悲痛啜泣的说道：“白爷爷，那些蒙面人为什么要杀我的爷爷，我的父母？灭我全族？每天夜里我都会梦见那个血腥的场面。
爹娘让我与白爷爷藏到祖庙暗道里，在那漆黑的祖庙暗道里，透过缝隙，我亲眼目睹爹娘及族人惨死在蒙面人的刀剑下，每次梦到这里我都会被惊醒。
我发誓一定要报仇，我一定要查出这帮蒙面人的来历，为死去的爷爷、爹娘、哥哥、叔伯们报仇。”

此时少年稚嫩的脸上已经满是泪水，他的眼神坚定，目光森冷，态度决然，这一切都与他的年龄形成强烈的反差。
白邵阳走到少年近前，轻轻拍拍少年肩膀说道：“少主，等到了白帝城的上官家，向上官家主禀明情况后我们再从长计议。”
张皓旸微微点头，随即又看向安平城张家的方向。
月光依旧，那远处的犬吠之声消失后，清冷的夜又迅速陷入一片死寂之中。

> Chapter 1 Wedge (Page 1)
In late autumn, in a dilapidated temple, there was an old man with gray hair and wrinkles leaning on an old wooden table to rest. A boy of 13 or 14 years old leaned beside him, with a layer of firewood spread under them.
Although the young man was dressed in ragged clothes and his face was covered with dust, he still could not hide the trace of heroism on his face. Both the old man and the young man looked tired.
The bright moonlight fills the earth, like covering the earth with a "silver gauze"
, a few barks of dogs were heard in the distance from time to time, and the atmosphere was desolate and cold.
The boy who had his eyes tightly closed suddenly blinked his eyelids a few times, and then screamed: "Don't kill my parents and my brother!"
The scream broke the silence of the cold night and caused several barks.
The old man was also awakened by the young man's scream. He turned his head and looked at the young man beside him. His face was full of kindness, and his eyes showed the doting feeling that only relatives can have.
The old man patted the young man's shoulder with great distress, and whispered to himself as if to comfort the young man beside him: "Young master, in the past half month, we have been on the run, hiding in Tibet, sleeping in the open, and running on the edge of death. Have you ever suffered like this?"
The old man wanted to pat the boy a few times to calm him down so he could sleep for a while, but the boy suddenly opened his eyes at this moment.
The young man looked at the old man with wide eyes, and there were crystal tears in his eyes. He calmed down and said, "Grandpa Bai, when can we get to grandpa's house?"
The old man, whom the boy called Grandpa Bai, said: "Young Master, at this rate, we will arrive in about five days."
The young man who spoke was named Zhang Haoyang, the young master of the Zhang family in Anping City, and the old man was a servant of his family named Bai Shaoyang.
The relationship between Bai Shaoyang and Zhang Haoyang's grandfather is extraordinary. Zhang Haoyang's grandfather Zhang Zhenlong saved Bai Shaoyang's life. In order to repay his life-saving grace, Bai Shaoyang protected the younger generation in the Zhang family as a servant.
Zhang Zhenlong's original intention was to be compatible with the Bai Shaoyang brothers, but Bai Shaoyang always disagreed and repeatedly refused on the grounds that the life-saving grace was like reborn parents. Seeing Bai Shaoyang's resolute attitude, Zhang Zhenlong could only follow his heart.
Although Bai Shaoyang appears as a servant in the Zhang family, everyone in the Zhang family has never treated Bai Shaoyang as a servant. Zhang Haoyang and his brother Zhang Haofeng even respectfully call Bai Shaoyang Grandpa Bai.
Zhang Haoyang slowly stood up and walked to the temple gate. He looked firmly in the direction of the Zhang family in Anping City. He said with some sadness and sobs: "Grandpa Bai, why did those masked men kill my grandfather and my parents? Destroy my entire family? Every night I dream of that bloody scene.
My parents asked me and Grandpa Bai to hide in the secret passage of the ancestral temple. In the dark secret passage of the ancestral temple, through the gap, I witnessed my parents and my clan members dying tragically under the swords of masked men. Every time I dreamed about this, I would wake up.
I vowed to take revenge. I must find out the origins of these masked men and avenge my dead grandfather, parents, brothers and uncles. "
At this time, the young man's immature face was already covered with tears. His eyes were firm, cold, and resolute, all of which were in sharp contrast to his age.
Bai Shaoyang walked up to the young man, patted the young man's shoulder gently and said, "Young master, wait until we get to the Shangguan family in Baidi City. We will make long-term plans after reporting the situation to the head of the Shangguan family."
Zhang Haoyang nodded slightly, and then looked in the direction of the Zhang family in Anping City.
The moonlight was still there, and after the distant barking of dogs disappeared, the cold night quickly fell into deathly silence.
